scene: The crane swings wide, parting steel gates to reveal three bustling exits.
picture: Side view of the busy foundry platform floor. On the far left, a striped airship waits at an open loading door. In the centre sits the girl in her purple wheelchair beside the crane. To her right idles a yellow delivery truck, and far right stands a glowing glass elevator with doors open.
shown: a moored striped zeppelin waiting at an open bay door far left
a yellow candy delivery truck idling with its ramp down on the right
a glowing cylindrical glass elevator with its sliding doors open far right
